title: world-heavyweight-nawc-council-1999
label: Dr. Hate

won.source: Won the tournament final in a lumberjack match against "The Cavalier" Tom Knight at the promotion's own first pay-per-view, Injustice For All, to become the first holder of the vacant title.

note: Lost the title to Thane Sloan, who reversed a finishing move into his own Educator for the pin.

title: world-heavyweight-nawc-council-1999
label: Thane Sloan

won.source: Countered Dr. Hate's own finisher into The Educator for the pin on Fight Night Friday.

note: Lost the title to Rio D. Giniro after Rick Stevens's ringside interference turned the match; Sloan and Giniro's own manager Al Capulco embraced each other in the ring afterward.

title: world-heavyweight-nawc-council-1999
label: Rio D. Giniro

won.source: Pinned Thane Sloan with the SunSet after Rick Stevens threw a set of brass knuckles into the ring for him.

note: Still champion at the close of the record read for this wing.

title: television-nawc-council-1999
label: Rio D. Giniro

won.source: Won a Royal Rumble on Fight Night Friday, in his promotion debut, to become the first holder of the vacant title.

note: Lost the title to Rick Stevens at Injustice For All, weeks after Stevens's valet Lady Divine had physically taken the belt from him at ringside.

title: television-nawc-council-1999
label: Rick Stevens

won.source: Pinned Rio D. Giniro with the Painkiller at Injustice For All.

note: Still champion at the close of the record read for this wing, having fought Tom Knight to a time-limit draw in a Hell in a Cell defense on 24 December.

title: intercontinental-nawc-council-1999
label: Killer Buddha

won.source: Pinned "Down Under" Derek Davies with Instant Karma in a restarted match, after outside interference had voided the first fall by disqualification, to become the first holder of the vacant title.

note: Still champion at the close of the record read for this wing.

title: lightweight-nawc-council-1999
label: Kasady

won.source: Left the last man standing in a six-man Last Man Standing match to become the first holder of the vacant title.

note: Still champion at the close of the record read for this wing.
